import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.io.common.StringIO("""amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Transaction amount distribution by type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for trans_type in data['transaction_type'].unique():
    subset = data[data['transaction_type'] == trans_type]
    ax1.scatter(subset['hour_of_day'], subset['amount'], 
               label=trans_type, alpha=0.7, s=100)
ax1.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day by Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Transaction type distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
type_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(type_counts))
ax2.bar(type_counts.index, type_counts.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Transaction Types', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. Transactions by hour of day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hour_counts = data['hour_of_day'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax3.plot(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='#2E86AB')
ax3.fill_between(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='#2E86AB')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Transaction Frequency by Hour', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))

# 4. Amount statistics summary
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
ax4.axis('off')
stats_text = f"""
Transaction Summary Statistics

Total Transactions: {len(data)}
Fraud Cases: {data['is_fraud'].sum()}
Non-Fraud Cases: {(data['is_fraud'] == 0).sum()}

Amount Statistics:
  Mean: ${data['amount'].mean():.2f}
  Median: ${data['amount'].median():.2f}
  Min: ${data['amount'].min():.2f}
  Max: ${data['amount'].max():.2f}
  Std Dev: ${data['amount'].std():.2f}

Transaction Types:
"""
for trans_type in data['transaction_type'].unique():
    count = (data['transaction_type'] == trans_type).sum()
    stats_text += f"  {trans_type.capitalize()}: {count}\n"

ax4.text(0.1, 0.5, stats_text, fontsize=11, verticalalignment='center',
         fontfamily='monospace', bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.3))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
